CAROL SKINNER'S BLOG: WHAT THE INTERNET ARCHIVE HOLDS
livelovelaughwithcarol.com -- "Live Love Laugh with Carol"
Inventory built 2026-09-07 FROM THIS ENVIRONMENT, which cannot read the
captures themselves. Prepared so that whoever opens an ordinary browser spends
minutes rather than an hour.

=====================================================================
THE CAPABILITY FINDING FIRST, BECAUSE IT IS REUSABLE
=====================================================================

p_416 recorded that "web.archive.org is blocked by THIS ENVIRONMENT'S egress
policy". THAT IS CONFIRMED, and now precisely:

  web.archive.org:443   the tunnel opens and is dropped mid-exchange
                        (ws_closed_mid_exchange, three retries, all identical)
  web.archive.org:80    HTTP 403, body "Blocked by egress policy" -- 24 bytes,
                        which is the proxy talking, not the archive
  timetravel.mementoweb.org  same drop as :443

BUT THE ARCHIVE'S AVAILABILITY API IS ON A DIFFERENT HOST AND IT WORKS:

  http://archive.org/wayback/available?url=<URL>&timestamp=<YYYYMMDD>

It returns the CLOSEST capture to a timestamp, with its date, HTTP status and
canonical web.archive.org URL. It will not return content, but probed timestamp
by timestamp it enumerates what exists. THAT IS THE WHOLE TECHNIQUE HERE, and
it is worth remembering the next time an archive.org subdomain is unreachable:
the block is per-host, and archive.org itself has been reachable all day.

=====================================================================
THE BLOG EXISTED AND WAS CAPTURED FOR AT LEAST SEVEN YEARS
=====================================================================

Front page, closest capture to 1 June of each year, all HTTP 200:

  2015-06-13   http://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com:80/
  2016-03-30   http://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com/
  2017-07-04   http://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com/
  2018-04-13   https://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com/
  2019-06-27   https://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com/
  2019-12-15   https://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com/     <- see below
  2020-08-06   https://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com/
  2021-05-15   https://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com/
  2022-01-23 · 2022-04-22 · 2022-08-16 · 2022-09-26        (all www.)

THE ONE INTERIOR PAGE CONFIRMED CAPTURED:

  /blog/       2019-12-15 13:40:35, HTTP 200
               http://web.archive.org/web/20191215134035/https://www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com/blog/

  The front page of the same crawl is 2019-12-15 13:28:13 -- twelve minutes
  earlier -- so THAT CRAWL WENT DEEPER THAN THE FRONT PAGE and is the one to
  start from. Whatever else it reached will be visible from the calendar view
  of that day.

=====================================================================
WHERE TO STOP, AND THIS IS THE IMPORTANT PART
=====================================================================

THE CAPTURES FROM 2023 ONWARD ARE PROBABLY NOT HER BLOG. f_4825 records that
the domain was taken over and now serves an Indonesian online-gambling site.
This inventory cannot read the pages, but it can see the URL FORM CHANGE:

  through 2022-09-26   every capture is of  www.livelovelaughwithcarol.com
  from   2023-04-01    every capture is of      livelovelaughwithcarol.com

A WordPress site on www. replaced by something on the bare domain, in a gap
where no capture at all is returned for January 2023, is what a domain change
of hands looks like. SO THE BOUNDARY LIES BETWEEN 26 SEPTEMBER 2022 AND
1 APRIL 2023. That is a signal and not a proof: nothing here has read either
side of it. Anyone browsing should treat 2022-09-26 as the last capture likely
to be hers and check the 2023-04-01 one before trusting anything later.

The /feed endpoint returns only a 2025 capture, which by the above is the
replacement site's feed and not hers.

=====================================================================
WHAT WAS PROBED AND FOUND ABSENT
=====================================================================

p_416 lists a section structure taken from search indexes -- Love Story, ALS,
Blog, Tips & Tricks, Gallery, Travel, Media. ONLY /blog/ RESOLVES. These were
tried and returned no capture at all:

  /als · /love-story · /about · /media · /gallery · /travel · /tips-tricks ·
  /contact · /my-story · /our-love-story · /the-love-story · /living-with-als ·
  /my-als · /category/blog · /2019/06 · /wp-content · /sitemap.xml

THAT IS NOT EVIDENCE THE SECTIONS WERE NEVER CAPTURED. It is evidence that
THESE GUESSED SLUGS ARE NOT THE REAL ONES -- the section names came from search
snippets, not from the site's own navigation, and a WordPress site's menu
labels rarely match its URLs. The real slugs will be on the front page of the
2019-12-15 capture, in its navigation bar. READ THE MENU FIRST, then follow it.

=====================================================================
WHAT IS BEING LOOKED FOR
=====================================================================

Her Kanawana years in her own words: which section(s) she directed, which
years, what she says the place was like. This is, per p_416, THE ONLY
FIRST-PERSON LONG-FORM SOURCE THIS PROJECT HAS EVER IDENTIFIED FOR ANY
KANAWANA PERSON WRITING ABOUT THEIR OWN LIFE. ALS Canada's 2021 memorial calls
the blog "a source of positivity and strength for many".

A NOTE ON HANDLING. She died in 2021 and the blog was public and written for
an audience, so quoting it is quoting a published work. Its subject is her
illness, and much of it will be about her body and her family rather than
about a summer camp. Take the camp material; leave the rest where she put it.
